title: The world is made of Fabulous.

text_block_list.text: Jewels. Countless talented treasures gather at Tracen Academy. And among them—
Even before debut, a brilliant foreign jewel radiated an overwhelming luster.

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Hehe, mock race time♪ Follow my lead, Dober! Let's get those legs loosened up first!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: This feels great! The turf, surrounding nature, and all those eyes glued to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejirodobel
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That gate break was way too fast! Can't even hit my top speed like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejirodobel
text_block_list.text: Pushing that kind of speed while staying so composed... And to think we're in the same grade...!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Now then, Dober, let's start from here! From here on out, even more― Haaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejirodobel
text_block_list.text: Kuh...!

text_block_list.name: Intermediate Trainer A
text_block_list.text: So that's the famous Seeking the Pearl, huh? She's so quick-witted, even the famed Mejiro Dober can't keep up with her pace.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, if this is just a mock race, it makes me look forward to the Debut Selection race even more. Don't you think so too?

Not only does she have a promising future ahead, but she's a prodigy capable of aiming for a G1 victory in the shortest time imaginable. There isn't a single trainer who wouldn't be captivated by her.
Seeking the Pearl. Just what kind of Umamusume is she...?

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Hohohoho! Just how much do you all know? About this fabulous world!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you've all seen it before. Right here!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: This is it―the Earth! Have you ever gazed upon every single corner of this globe?
The Earth. Through a grand speech utilizing her globe, her unique character became crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: I was born in the United States of America, and I've traveled all across the world since I was a little girl. And...

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: I've touched the diverse cultures of each land, meeting all kinds of people!

text_block_list.name: The old guide lady.
text_block_list.text: Here, little lady, take a look. This is the grand royal palace.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow, that is so utterly breathtaking♪

text_block_list.name: The old guide lady.
text_block_list.text: Someday, you might even live in a place like this, you know? I'm certain you can do it, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: Those precious experiences gave me a grand vision!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: What I am aiming for... world-famous wonders! Timeless traditions! Exquisite confections! To become a dazzling girl who shines brighter than all of them combined!

text_block_list.name: Seaking Zapar
text_block_list.text: I shall illuminate everyone across the globe! Perhaps through the world of racing! Yes... I am absolutely certain of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejirodobel
text_block_list.text: Pearl, what in the world are you talking about with 'sweets' and 'perhaps'?
She brims with absolute confidence, with a touch of dramatic humor. Everyone can sense the grandeur of her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Intermediate Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wait, Seeking the Pearl! Team up with me! I can polish your top speed to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Intermediate Trainer B
text_block_list.text: No, you should team up with me! I specialize in creating captivating race strategies. Don't you want to run races that make the entire audience gasp in awe?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Polishing my speed, making the fans gasp in wonder... None of those sound bad at all. But still...
Even trainers with proven track records couldn't pique her interest. Getting her attention really is going to be a tough task.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Isn't there an even more amazing dream out there? Hey, you there, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Can you think of something? An exquisitely gorgeous dream that can truly intoxicate me?
Perhaps I just happened to catch her eye. Seeking the Pearl turned her teasing, playful gaze right toward me.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. I rack my brain desperately. What kind of dream truly befits the dazzling talent I witnessed in that mock race―
choice_data_list: 俺と一緒に『世界』を夢中にさせよう！
私と一緒に『世界』を夢中にさせよう！

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Oh my... 'making the whole world fall head over heels'... is it?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: ...To be sure, I am a world-class pearl. Even if I'm still an unpolished gem. But you're still a rookie trainer yourself, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: So how can you proclaim something as grandiose as 'making the world fall in love'? Do you actually have a concrete plan?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ So you really hadn't thought it through at all. Having sheer ambition is wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: I would have preferred to see a realistic map. A world map uniquely drawn by you, that is.
Words that just slipped out on impulse. She saw right through the complete lack of substance behind them. And then―

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainers♪ I appreciate all your enthusiastic love calls, but I'd like you to hold off on scouting me until after you've witnessed my true, serious run.

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Yes, the Debut Selection race! I shall triumph on that very stage! Even over that particular Umamusume!
For a fleeting moment, a sharp, serious glint cut through Seeking the Pearl's otherwise effortless composure.
In the upcoming Debut Selection race, who could be 'that Umamusume' she views as her ultimate rival―?

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Pearl-san! Let's have a great race today, yessiree!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: There you are, Taiki. As always, you're radiating an aura powerful enough to make my heart shake.

text_block_list.name: タイキシャトル
text_block_list.text: YES! My condition is in tip-top shape! Nobody can stop the Kentucky Express, no way!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Indeed. An ordinary Umamusume wouldn't stand a chance of keeping up. But in my dictionary, the word 'impossible' does not exist! No, in fact―

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: I threw away all dictionaries the moment I was born! Rather than a thousand words, one simply has to accomplish it!

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーA
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl vs. Taiki Shuttle, huh? It's a clash between two phenomenal talents born in America.

text_block_list.name: 中堅トレーナーB
text_block_list.text: Yeah, when it comes to pure speed, they might already surpass the older generation. Who will end up taking the crown...?

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho-ho! Why, that would obviously be me! I shall claim victory without fail and demonstrate my infinite potential!

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: Indeed, a peerless pearl of the highest caliber! No matter how fast Taiki may be, this radiant brilliance holds not a single cloud―
*Dummy text for sound effect.*

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: O-Oh my? While there are no clouds upon me―

text_block_list.name: シーキングザパール
text_block_list.text: The sky seems to disagree. What a sudden, lazy downpour.
The sudden rainfall quickly drenches the ground beneath their feet. And so―
The clash between American express trains was set to unfold upon a heavy, muddy track.
